summary: Above Food Ingredients Inc. (issuer) filed a Form 6-K reporting a Nasdaq Hearings Panel determination to delist its common shares and warrants due to non-compliance with filing audited financial statements and Form 20-F by the extension deadline. Trading will be suspended June 2, 2026. The company expects securities to trade on the OTCQX market under symbol ABVEE, posing liquidity risk. It is considering an appeal to the Nasdaq Listing and Hearing Review Council and working to meet re-listing requirements. Watch for timeline of audit completion and appeal outcome.
